span.p:
inbox record-link-queued Lambda
256 MB / 30 s, batchSize 1
dispatch on detail-type —
unknown type or unparseable URL
fails the record (never defaults)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
markLinkSaved
unconditional PutItem —
re-published facts and re-saves
converge on the same row

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
markLinkSaveFailed
conditional PutItem
(attribute_not_exists OR state <> saved)
— an accepted save outranks a failure

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
retractLinkSaved
DeleteItem — absence IS the
not-saved state; idempotent
under redelivery

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
hutch-inbox-saved-links
PK userId, SK sha256(normalized url)
state: saved | failed — no third state;
row carries the raw url for the console

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DLQ + alarm → SNS email
(alarm-only: single-row writes —
exhaustion means DynamoDB was down,
or a producer broke its contract)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
hutch delete-account Lambda
deleteAllByUserId (partition drop,
bypasses the fact stream)
